Class TowerTest

java.lang.Object
models.base.TowerTest
class TowerTest extends Object
Tests for Tower — a concrete Unit subclass with no attack/movement. Tower's constructor only calls Unit's constructor which wraps image loading in try-catch, so these tests run without a JavaFX toolkit.
